# 当前仅接受 issue / Issues only for now

本项目目前只接受 issue（bug 报告、功能建议），不接受外部代码 PR。收到的外部代码 PR 会被礼貌关闭。

欢迎到 issue 描述问题、复现步骤、预期行为和想法，请勿粘贴大段代码或敏感信息。安全漏洞请通过 [SECURITY.md](../SECURITY.md) 中的私密渠道报告。

This project currently accepts issues only: bug reports and feature suggestions. External code PRs are not accepted and will be politely closed.

Please describe problems, reproduction steps, expected behavior and ideas in an issue. Do not paste large blocks of code or sensitive information. Report security vulnerabilities privately as described in [SECURITY.md](../SECURITY.md).
